candidateEntities.claimCeiling: Read-only client workspace analytics, real DB-backed read model, no seeded metric — operator dashboard feature.
The first capability making real opportunity generation reachable by a real operator, with a P2-passed human-decision experience (truthful error and zero-strong-story states).
Real evidence preview (source-moment video, timestamp ranges, rationale) with a durable zero-strong-opportunity empty state, P2-passed for the canonical operator dashboard.
This capability binds Instagram credentials at the provider boundary; it is a building block for the one proven operator-bound publish, not a general publish capability.
A real JSON2Video native render (RenderRecipe -> movie spec -> polled render -> provider URL) has been proven once, end to end, against the real provider.

The full golden path — Produce -> Review -> Publish — has been run once for real, against a real render provider, real R2 storage and a real Instagram account, ending in a real published Reel with a captured permalink.
Durable Produce -> Review job orchestration (idempotent, crash-resumable, single-live-job-per-item) is implemented and tested; its schema was applied and verified on a real isolated preview database.
Publication identity (external_post_id, permalink) is captured and durable for the one proven real Instagram publish.
A real Submagic render contract (duration field, no synthetic fallback) is proven live once, for one project.

sourceDisclosure: Built by shelling out to `npm run public-truth:build` in a local checkout of the product repository at the path given to content:sync, then reading its .artifacts output directly off disk. No network call. No published/CI manifest artifact exists yet to fetch instead.
